Hi Alyssa —

Congrats again on signing — excited to get going. Attached is a first-cut Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short evaluation checklist we use for go/no-go canary runs. High-level proposal below; details are in MedlineAI_MAP_v1.2.xlsx and the Canary_Runbook.pdf attached.

Summary milestone suggestions
- Kickoff workshop: Thu, 2026-09-24, 10:00–11:30 PT — technical + product + ops (please confirm attendees)
- Staging validation & training: 2026-09-27 – 2026-10-02 — training sessions (2 x 90m) + synthetic load tests
- Canary: 2026-10-05 – 2026-10-09 — 5% traffic, 2x daily checks, p95 latency and quality gates
- Production cutover (target): 2026-10-19 — low-traffic weekend window, rollback plan included

Evaluation & success criteria (first pass)
- Latency: p95 inference < 250ms for typical payloads (see runbook for size buckets)
- Quality: top-line generative precision within 2% of baseline on core prompts (prompt set included)
- Cost: token cost not to exceed agreed unit economics (see SOW appendix B)
- Reliability: error rate <0.5% sustained during canary period

Roles / owners (draft)
- Redwood: Jordan (Customer success handoff + PM), Marissa (Implementation lead), Rishi (Platform/runbook), Lauren (Training & onboarding)
- MedlineAI: Alyssa (Project sponsor), Tom (SRE contact)

Open asks before kickoff
1) Confirm kickoff attendees and required SSO/SCIM contacts so we can provision staging earlier.
2) Please share any blackout dates between Oct 5–19 (we can slide the canary if needed).
3) If you have a preferred data retention window for logs/audit events, flag it in reply.

Attachments: MedlineAI_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (MAP tabs: timeline, owners, risk register), Canary_Runbook.pdf, SOW_Redwood_MedlineAI_v1.docx (draft)

I’ll follow up with a short calendar invite and the kickoff agenda this afternoon.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth rollout.
